overworld.label: Overworld / route theme
overworld.use_for: Walking routes between towns; the default exploration loop.
overworld.prompt_suffix: Upbeat, adventurous handheld-RPG overworld theme in the style of late-1990s Game Boy Color games. Bright chiptune-leaning instrumentation with a hummable lead melody, steady walking tempo around 130 BPM, warm and nostalgic. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.

town.label: Town / village theme
town.prompt_suffix: Cosy, gentle village theme for a retro handheld RPG. Relaxed mid-tempo, friendly major-key melody, soft chiptune bells and rounded synth, welcoming and peaceful. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.

battle.label: Wild encounter battle
battle.prompt_suffix: Energetic, driving battle theme for a retro handheld creature-RPG. Fast tempo around 150 BPM, punchy chiptune lead, urgent bassline, exciting but not menacing. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.

boss.label: Champion / boss battle
boss.prompt_suffix: Dramatic, high-stakes boss battle theme for a retro handheld RPG. Intense and heroic, minor key with a triumphant motif, fast tempo, bold chiptune brass-like leads and pounding percussion. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.

victory.label: Victory fanfare
victory.prompt_suffix: Short triumphant victory fanfare in classic handheld-RPG style. Bright, celebratory, ascending chiptune melody, resolves cleanly. Fully instrumental, no vocals. A brief jingle, not a loop.

cave.label: Cave / dungeon theme
cave.prompt_suffix: Atmospheric, mysterious cave theme for a retro handheld RPG. Slow-to-mid tempo, sparse echoing chiptune notes, slightly tense and wondrous minor key, sense of depth and exploration. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.

title.label: Title screen theme
title.prompt_suffix: Sweeping, nostalgic title-screen theme for a retro handheld creature-collecting RPG. Grand but warm, memorable main motif, evokes the start of a childhood adventure, classic chiptune-orchestral blend. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.

emotional.label: Emotional / story moment
emotional.prompt_suffix: Tender, emotional theme for a story moment in a retro handheld RPG. Slow, heartfelt melody, soft chiptune piano-like and string-like tones, bittersweet and nostalgic. Fully instrumental, seamless looping, no vocals.
